page.content:
Soul-stealing sorcerer who hosts the tournament for Outworld.

How Shang Tsung connects

  • Location: Outworld — Shang Tsung hosts Mortal Kombat to feed Shao Kahn's Outworld.
  • Event: Mortal Kombat tournament — Shang Tsung hosted the island Mortal Kombat tournament.
  • Work: Mortal Kombat 1 — Mortal Kombat 1 immediately sets Shang Tsung against Liu Kang's new history.

What is Shang Tsung?

Shang Tsung is the shapeshifting sorcerer who ran the island tournament in Mortal Kombat (1992), stealing souls for Shao Kahn and later rewriting timelines for himself.

Key threads lead to Outworld, Mortal Kombat tournament and Mortal Kombat 1.
